components.text: Click or hover on each card to flip it and test your knowledge. Complete all 10 cards to reinforce your memory retention!

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time.
The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.
(Of a sound) sweet or musical; pleasant to hear.
A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.
Too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words.
A pleasant smell that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.
A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage.
(Of a network) like a labyrinth; irregular and twisting.
